Ingredients: ['6 -7 ounces tortilla chips (about1/2 a bag)', '2 cups cheddar cheese, grated', '1 small red onion, quartered then sliced thin', '12 cup Major Grey chutney or 12 cup mango salsa', '12 cup plain yogurt', '12 cup fresh cilantro, chopped']
Instructions: ['Spread tortillas out on a foil lined rimmed baking sheet and layer with cheese and onion; bake in a 450 degree F oven until the cheese melts, about 3 to 5 minutes.', 'Top with chutney (or salsa), yogurt, and cilantro; serve.']

Name: Rustic Brown Bread (Abm)
Ingredients: ['1 egg, beaten', '1 cup water', '2 tablespoons butter', '2 tablespoons molasses', '1 tablespoon brown sugar', '1 12 cups whole wheat bread flour', '1 cup white bread flour', '12 cup oats', '13 cup cornmeal', '1 14 teaspoons salt', '1 teaspoon bread machine yeast']
Instructions: ["ADD ingredients to machine according toyour bread machine manufacturer's directions."]

Name: My Moms Super Power Salad
Ingredients: ['3 Tablespoons Peanut Butter', '1 Tablespoon Honey', '1 teaspoon Freshly Grated Ginger', '1 Tablespoon Rice Vinegar', '1 teaspoon Sesame Oil', '2 Tablespoons Water', '4 cups Washed And Cut Lettuce (red, Green Or Romaine)', '2 cups Baby Spinach', '1 cup Cooked Red Rice', '1/2 cups Cashews', '1/4 cups Pumpkin Seeds', '1/4 cups Dried Cranberries', '1 whole Avocado']
Instructions: ['To prepare dressing, warm peanut butter and honey in microwave for 1015 seconds until peanut butter is thinned.', 'Whisk in remaining dressing ingredients.', 'Set aside.', 'Mix lettuce and spinach.', 'Place vegetables on the bottom of a large salad bowl.', 'Scatter rice, cashews, pumpkin seeds and dried cranberries on top.', 'Cut avocado in cubes and put it on salad.', 'Drizzle dressing on top and serve.']

Name: Garden Patch Quick Bread
Ingredients: ['1 12 cups self-rising flour', '12 cup cornmeal', '2 teaspoons dill', '1 teaspoon rosemary', '1 14 cups buttermilk', '1 egg', '2 tablespoons olive oil', '12 cup applesauce', '1 clove minced garlic', '12 cup grated zucchini', '14 cup diced tomatoes', '14 cup grated carrot', '12 cup chopped broccoli', '14 cup corn', '14 cup minced onion', '14 cup shelled sunflower seeds']
Instructions: ['Preheat oven to 350 degrees.', 'Grease a loaf pan.', 'In a large bowl, combine all dry ingredients.', 'In a separate bowl, combine buttermilk, 1 tablepoon oil, egg, applesauce.', 'Add wet ingredients and vegetables to dry ingredients.', 'Stir until blended.', 'PLace batter in loaf pan.', 'Brush with remaining olive oil and sprinkle with sunflower seeds.', 'Bake for 50-60 minutes or until pick comes out clean.']

Name: Salata Orientala
Ingredients: ['2 12 lbs redskinned potatoes', '1 medium red onion, sliced', '1 green pepper, seeded and sliced into rings', '2 tablespoons oil', '2 tablespoons wine vinegar', 'salt', 'fresh ground black pepper', 'black olives (to garnish)', 'grape tomatoes (to garnish)']
Instructions: ['Cook potatoes in their skins till done.', 'Cool a little, then peel and slice in 1/8" slices and place in serving bowl.', 'Add onion slices and green pepper rings.', 'Season with salt and pepper.', 'Whisk oil and vinegar together and pour over potatoes.', 'Mix gently.', 'Garnish with olives, tomatoes if desired.', 'Serve chilled or at room temperature.', 'Makes about 4 servings.']

Name: Benihana Hibachi Meat
Ingredients: ['34 lb boneless beef top loin steaks, sliced thin or 34 lb boneless chicken, cut into bite size pieces or 34 lb shrimp, deveined or 34 lb scallops', '1 tablespoon grated apple', '2 tablespoons soy sauce', '1 tablespoon grated garlic', '1 tablespoon sesame oil', '1 tablespoon sesame seeds']
Instructions: ['Mix all marinade ingredients in a bowl.', 'Marinate meat in the sauce for 30 min or longer.', 'Heat a frying pan or flat grill on high heat and stir-fry the meat until desired doneness a few minutes at most.']

Name: Cheesy Bacon Vegetable Toss
Ingredients: ['2 cups broccoli florets', '2 cups cauliflower florets Safeway 1 lb For $1.99 thru 02/09', '4 carrots (1/2 lb.), diagonally cut into thin slices', '2 Tbsp. water', '2 slices OSCAR MAYER Bacon, chopped', '1/4 lb. (4 oz.) 2% Milk VELVEETA, cut into 1/2-inch cubes', '2 green onions, sliced', "1/4 cup BREAKSTONE'S Reduced Fat or KNUDSEN Light Sour Cream"]
Instructions: ['Combine broccoli, cauliflower and carrots in large microwaveable casserole.', 'Add water; cover with lid.', 'Microwave on HIGH 5 to 6 min.', 'or until vegetables are crisp-tender.', 'Meanwhile, cook bacon in small saucepan on medium heat until crisp.', 'Remove bacon from pan; drain on paper towels.', 'Discard drippings from pan.', 'Add VELVEETA and onions to pan; cook on low heat 1 min.', 'or until VELVEETA is melted and mixture is well blended, stirring constantly.', 'Stir in sour cream and bacon.', 'Drain microwaved vegetables; return to casserole.', 'Add VELVEETA sauce; toss to coat.']

Name: Chicken Rice Vermicelli Soup
Ingredients: ['8 cups water', '1 12 cups celery, sliced', '1 cup carrot, diced', '4 cups chicken, cooked and cubed', '150 g rice vermicelli (chicken flavour)', '2 -4 teaspoons low-sodium instant chicken bouillon granules']
Instructions: ['In large saucepan, bring water, celery and carrots to a boil.', 'Stir in cubed chicken, rice/vermicelli mix and bouillon.', 'Return to a boil then reduce heat, cover and simmer 15-20 minutes or til rice is tender.']

Name: Eggs and Hash
Ingredients: ['12 cup butter', '2 medium onions, diced', '1 lb frozen cubed hash brown potatoes, thawed', '1 lb diced cooked corned beef', '8 eggs']
Instructions: ['In a big skillet, melt the butter over medium-high heat.', 'Saute the onions for 3-4 minutes or until they are soft.', 'Add in the hash brown potatoes and cook, stirring frequently, for 10-12 minutes.', 'Add in the corned beef and cook 5-6 minutes or until heated through.', 'Season with salt and pepper if necessary.', 'Transfer mixture to a 13 x 9 inch baking dish coated with non-stick cooking spray.', 'With a serving-size spoon, make eight evenly spaced indentations about 1/2 inch deep in the mixture.', 'Crack the eggs (one at a time) and allow the raw egg to drop into an indentation.', 'Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until the eggs are cooked to your desired degree of firmness.']

Name: Baked Codfish with Irish Cheese Crust
Ingredients: ['4 (6-ounce) codfish fillets, skins removed', 'Essence, recipe follows', '1/2 cup fine bread crumbs', '2 tablespoons melted Irish butter', '2 tablespoons minced fresh parsley', "2 teaspoons Lakeshore Strong Irish Mustard or Colman's English mustard", '2 teaspoons minced garlic, or spring onions', '6 ounces Irish cheese, such as Dubliner, Coolea, or Carrigaline, or Irish cheddar such as Kerrygold Vintage, grated', '1 cup heavy Irish cream', '2 1/2 tablespoons paprika', '2 tablespoons salt', '2 tablespoons garlic powder', '1 tablespoon black pepper', '1 tablespoon onion powder', '1 tablespoon cayenne pepper', '1 tablespoon dried oregano', '1 tablespoon dried thyme']
Instructions: ['Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Butter a casserole dish and set aside.', 'Lightly season the codfish on both sides with Essence and place in the prepared dish, skin side down.', 'In a bowl, combine the bread crumbs, butter, parsley, mustard, and garlic, and mix well.', 'Add the cheese and mix well.', 'Place on the fish, patting down to make a crust.', 'Pour the cream over the fish and bake until the fish is cooked through, golden brown and the cheese is bubbly, 15 to 20 minutes.', 'Remove from the oven and serve.', 'Combine all ingredients thoroughly.', 'Yield: 2/3 cup', 'Recipe from ?New New Orleans Cooking?, by Emeril Lagasse and Jessie Tirsch Published by William and Morrow, 1993.']

Name: Easy Sweet Sour Sauce Recipe
Ingredients: ['1 c. sugar', '1 c. white vinegar', '1 c. catsup', '1 c. water']
Instructions: ['Mix together ingredients in a saucepan.', 'Cook over low heat till thick and bubbly, about 1 hour.', '(Mix will be even thicker when cold.)', 'Makes about 2 c..', 'Sauce keeps indefinitely in the refrigerator.']

Name: Blackberry Buckle
Ingredients: ['4 cups fresh blackberries', '1 12 tablespoons granulated sugar', '1 teaspoon fresh lemon juice', '12 teaspoon vanilla extract', '6 tablespoons butter', '1 14 cups all-purpose flour', '34 cup granulated sugar', '2 teaspoons baking powder', '1 pinch salt', '18 teaspoon ground cinnamon', '1 cup milk', '12 teaspoon vanilla extract', '1 12 tablespoons turbinado sugar']
Instructions: ['Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.', 'In a small bowl, combine the first four ingredients and set aside.', 'Place the butter In a 2 quart baking dish and place it in the oven to melt the butter.', 'In a medium bowl combine the flour, 3/4 cup granulated sugar, baking powder, salt and cinnamon.', 'In a small bowl combine the milk and vanilla.', 'Add this mixture to the flour mixture.', 'Mix until moist.', 'Remove the baking dish from the oven.', 'Spread the batter on top of the butter.', 'The melted butter will peek up around the edges a bit.', 'Layer the blackberry mix on top of the batter.', 'Press the blackberries down into the batter a bit.', 'Bake for 45 minutes.', 'Sprinkle with the coarse sugar and bake for 5-10 more minutes or until the batter has reached a beautiful golden brown.']

Name: Southwestern Pizza Recipe
Ingredients: ['1 (13 inch) uncooked pizza crusts', '8 ounces shredded monterey jack cheese', '14 cup sour cream', '14 cup diced tomato, drained', '14 cup sliced jalapeno pepper', '14 teaspoon black peppercorns, crushed', 'extra virgin olive oil']
Instructions: ['dont forget to add 1/2 cups Southwestern oil sauce.', 'Top dough crust with oil sauce, cheese, dollops of sour cream, tomato, jalapenos, and pepper.', 'Drizzle with oil.', 'Bake in preheated 500 F oven on pizza stone for 8-10 minutes or until crust is golden brown and cheese is bubbly.', 'Remove from oven and cool on a wire rack for 2-3 minutes before cutting into wedges and serving.']

Name: Savory Ricotta and Scallion Scones
Ingredients: ['2 cups Unbleached All-purpose Flour', '1 Tablespoon Baking Powder', '3/4 Tablespoons Granulated Sugar', '1/2 teaspoons Salt', '5 Tablespoons Chilled Unsalted Butter, Cut Into 1/4-inch Cubes', '1/2 cups Chopped Scallions', '1 cup Ricotta Cheese', '23 cups Milk', '1 Egg, Beaten With 1 Teaspoon Water For Egg Wash', 'Sea Salt, Black Pepper And Smoked Paprika For Topping']
Instructions: ['Heat oven to 425 degrees F. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.', 'Cut in butter using a pastry blender or two knives until mixture resembles a coarse meal.', 'Stir in scallions and ricotta cheese.', 'Add milk and stir until just combined and a shaggy dough forms.', 'Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead gently into a ball.', 'Carefully pat down ball into a 1-inch-tall rectangle; divide into 8 equal pieces.', 'Carefully transfer scones to an ungreased baking sheet.', 'Brush tops with egg wash and sprinkle with sea salt, black pepper and smoked paprika.', 'Bake 15-20 minutes or until scones are golden brown and puffy.', 'Remove from oven; cool 5 minutes before serving.', 'Inspired by Joy the Baker and Smitten Kitchen.']

Name: Shrimp Jambalaya Recipe
Ingredients: ['1 slice bacon, cut into sm. pcs', '1 sm. onion, diced', '1 clove garlic, chopped', '1 sm. green pepper, diced', '1 1/2 c. tomato sauce', '1 c. smoked ham, diced', '1 pound raw shrimp, peeled & deveined', '1 tbsp. Creole seasoning', '4 c. water', '1 c. rice']
Instructions: ['Cook bacon in pan for 2 min.', 'Add in onion, garlic and pepper.', 'Saute/fry till transparent.', 'Add in tomato sauce, ham and shrimp.', 'Sprinkle with seasoning.', 'Cook 5 min.', 'Add in water and rice.', 'Simmer till rice is tender, about 30 min.', 'Extra cayenne pepper may be added.', 'Serves 4 to 6.', 'Serve with tossed salad and French bread, brushed with extra virgin olive oil, garlic pwdr, oregano and toasted.']

Name: All-In-One Hot Dog Mustard
Ingredients: ['1 (16 ounce) jar yellow mustard', '13 cup ketchup', '13 cup sweet pickle relish, drained']
Instructions: ['Mix all ingredients in a bowl.', 'Spoon into clean jars.', 'Cover and refrigerate.']

Name: Pan-Seared Salmon with Tomato-Olive Salsa
Ingredients: ['4 whole Roma Tomatoes, Seeded And Diced', '1/4 cups Pitted Kalamata Olives, Chopped', '2 Tablespoons Capers, Drained', '1/4 cups Chopped Basil Leaves', '2 cloves Garlic, Minced', '1 Tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil', '1/4 teaspoons Freshly Ground Black Pepper', '6 whole 6 Ounce Size Fresh Center-cut Salmon Fillets', '3 Tablespoons Olive Oil', '2 teaspoons Kosher Salt', '1 teaspoon Freshly Ground Black Pepper']

Name: Eggplant Lasagna
Ingredients: ['1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil', '1 medium onion, cut into thick slices', '1 garlic clove, minced', '1 12 cups canned crushed tomatoes', '1 12 teaspoons dried basil', '1 12 teaspoons dried oregano', '1 medium eggplant, peeled and sliced very thin', '2 large tomatoes, sliced very thin', '1 12 cups shredded reduced-fat mozzarella cheese']
Instructions: ['Preheat the oven to 425F Coat an 8" square baking dish with cooking spray.', 'Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.', 'Add the onion and cook, turning once, for 5 minutes, or until lightly browned.', 'Place in the prepared pan.', 'Add the garlic to the same skillet and cook for 1 minute.', 'Add the crushed tomatoes, basil, and oregano.', 'Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.', 'Spread about 1/3 of the tomato mixture over the onion layer.', 'Arrange 1/3 of the eggplant over the tomatoes and top with 1/3 of the sliced tomato.', 'Top with 1/3 of the cheese.', 'Repeat the layers two times.', 'Cover with aluminum foil.', 'Bake for 25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.', 'Uncover and bake for 10-15 minutes longer, or until the cheese is lightly browned.']

Name: Bottled Apple Pie Filling Recipe

Name: Flora's Slap Yo Momma Dirt Cake
Ingredients: ['20 Oreos divided', '2 tbsp Butter, softened', '1 8oz block of Cream Cheese', '1/2 cup Peanut Butter', '1 1/2 cup Powdered sugar, divided', '1 16oz container of cool whip', '15 Miniature Reeces Cups, chopped', '1 cup Milk', '1 box of Jello instant chocolate pudding 3.9oz']
Instructions: ['Crush 16 oreo cookies, mix with the butter and lay on the bottom of a 8 inch dish to make a crust.', 'In a medium sized bowl mix the cream cheese, peanut butter, and a cup of the powdered sugar.', 'Mix until smooth.', 'Then add half on the container of cool whip and fold together.', 'Lay it on top of the oreo crust.', 'Add the chopped reeces candy on top of the peanut butter mixture.', 'In a medium sized bowl mix the pudding with the remaining 1/2 cup of powdered sugar and the cup of milk for 2 min.', 'Let sit for 2 min then combine the remaining cool whip and fold together.', 'Layer on top of the reeces candys.', 'Now top the dish with the crumbs of the remaining oreos and some of the reeces cups if you really wanna go all out.', 'Refrigerate for at least 3 hrs before serving.', 'Enjoy!', 'Almost forgot to mention this recipe came from Pinterest.', 'I like saving ones I wanna remake on here.', 'Plus its fun to share.']

Name: Maple Summer Sausage
Ingredients: ['20 ounces beef summer sausage ("beefstick")', '1 cup maple syrup', '2 tablespoons butter']
Instructions: ['Slice summer sausage into 1/4" rounds - remove plastic coating from around sausage after you slice as it is easier that way.', 'Heat butter into large skillet completely coating bottom.', 'Add syrup, slightly stir and let sit on medium heat until bubbling slightly.', 'Place rounds into pan and let cook 3-4 minutes until bubbled up (like bologna) and a rich red color on bottom, turn and cook other side, they may not bubble back the other way but 3-4 minutes should be good.', 'Remove from pan onto plate, twisting them over the pan to get rid of any excess syrup.', 'Enjoy!']

Name: Southern Banana Pudding
Ingredients: ['2 Tablespoons Butter', '1-13 cup Sugar, Divided', '13 cups Flour', '2 whole Eggs (Yolks And Whites Separated)', '2 cups Milk', '18 teaspoons Salt', '1 box (12 Oz. Box) Vanilla Wafers', '4 whole Bananas, Sliced', '1 teaspoon Vanilla (or More Depending On Taste Preference)']
Instructions: ['Preheat oven to 425 degrees F.', 'In a pot, combine butter, 1 cup sugar, flour, egg yolks, milk, and salt.', 'Whisk together over medium heat.', 'Leave on heat about 10 minutes or until thick, stirring occasionally.', 'Line a 2-quart baking dish with vanilla wafers, top with two bananas, sliced.', 'Take custard mixture off heat.', 'Stir in vanilla until custard reaches peak deliciousness.', 'Pour half of the custard mixture over the bananas in the baking dish.', 'Repeat layering: wafers, banana slices, custard.', 'In a bowl mix egg whites on high speed.', 'Gradually add the remaining 1/3 cup sugar.', 'Continue mixing until soft peaks form.', 'Pour on top of the pudding mix.', 'Bake about 4 minutes or until the meringue browns slightly.']

Name: Gut-Busting Smokehouse Burger
Ingredients: ['1 lb ground beef', "3 tablespoons smoky barbecue sauce (your own or bottled; I like Uncle Dougie's from Barrington, IL)", '5 -6 dashes TABASCO brand Chipotle Pepper Sauce', '1 12 teaspoons liquid smoke (or to taste)', '12 small onion, thinly sliced', '14 lb smoked gouda cheese or 14 lb cheddar cheese, preferably at room temperature (enough to have 2 tbsp. per burger)', '14 lb thinly sliced smoked ham (enough for 3 or 4 thin slices per burger)', '12 tablespoon olive oil', '2 -3 good sandwich buns (I like the ones dusted with cornmeal)', 'more barbecue sauce', 'i like to use a little jack daniels hickory smoke mustard']
Instructions: ['In olive oil, briefly saute ham slices and onion slices together until lightly browned.', 'Remove and wrap in foil to keep warm in oven.', 'Mix barbecue sauce, chipotle Tabasco sauce, and Liquid Smoke into ground sirloin.', 'Separate into 2 or 3 servings, then separate again to make two separate patties per burger.', 'Layer smoked cheese of choice in the center; cover with"matching" patty and seal edges tightly.', "At this point, you can either cook the cheese-stuffed patties in the same skillet used to saute the ham and onions, or throw'em on the grill (mmmmmmm!)", 'For the pan-frying method, it will take about 7 minutes per side for the two burgers (1/2 pound size).', 'To serve, top each burger with 3 or 4 slices of ham and some onions.', 'I like to serve with more barbecue sauce and Jack Daniels Hickory Smoke mustard.']

Name: Steamed Cafe Sponge Pudding with Cocoa Sauce
Ingredients: ['2 tablespoons vegan margarine', '2 tablespoons soft brown sugar', '2 eggs', '13 cup unbleached all-purpose flour', '34 teaspoon baking powder', '6 tablespoons milk', '1 teaspoon coffee extract', '1 14 cups milk', '1 tablespoon light brown sugar', '1 teaspoon unsweetened cocoa', '2 tablespoons cornstarch', '4 tablespoons cold water']
Instructions: ['First grease a 2 cup heatproof bowl.', 'In a medium bowl, cream your margarine and sugar until the are light and fluggy, and then beat your eggs into this mixture.', 'Next, stir in the flour a little at a time, and then add the baking powder.', 'Stir in milk and coffee extract, combining until it forms a smooth batter.', 'Spoon this mixture into the prepared heatproof bowl, and cover the bowl with a pleated piece of baking parchment, and then a pleated piece of foil, making sure to form it around the bowl, and then secure with string.', 'Place bowl in a steamer or large pan and half fill steamer or pan with boiling water.', 'Cover the steamer or pan for 1-1 1/4 hours, until cooked through.', 'For the sauce, put milk, brown sugar and cocoa in a medium saucepan and heat on low just until the sugar dissolves.', 'Blend the cornstarch with 4 tablespoons cold water to make a smooth paste, and stir into the pan.', 'Turn heat up (med-high) and bring to a boil, stirring until smooth and thickened.', 'Reduce to low-med and cook over gentle heat for 1 minute.', 'When 1-1 1/4 hour (s) has passed, remove the string, foil, and paper, and turn the Sponge pudding out onto a serving plate and spoon sauce over the top.', 'Serve immediately.', '(NOTE: the pudding is covered with pleated paper and foil to allow it to rise.', 'It will not rise if you do not do this properly.)', 'The foil reacts with the steam and must therefore not be placed directly against the pudding-- be sure to place the paper under the foil.']

Name: Boogers On A Stick Recipe
Ingredients: ['1 jar cheez whiz (8 ounce.) Green food coloring', '25 x pretzel sticks (to 30) Waxed paper', '1 x Long handled spoon Platter']
Instructions: ['With an adults help, heat the cheeze whiz in the microwave or possibly on top of the stove, according to directions on the jar.', 'Allow the cheese to cold slightly in the jar.', 'Using a long handled spoon, carefully stir about three drops of green food coloring into the hot cheese, using just sufficient to turn the cheese a delicate snot green.', 'To create boogers: Dip and twist the tip of each prtezel stick into the cheese, lift out, wait twenty seconds, then dip again.', 'When cheese lumps reach an appealingly boogerish size, set pretzels, booger down, onto a sheet of waxed paper.', 'Allow finished boogers on a stick to cold at room temperature for ten min or possibly till cheese is hard.', 'Gently pull boogers off waxed paper and arrange on a serving platter.', 'Serves 5 to 6 booger buddies.', 'Sicko Serving Suggestion: Place a bowl of chunky red salsa in the center of the platter so which guests can turn plain buggers into bloody ones.']

Name: The Real Jamaican Jerk Chicken - Nearly Too Hot to Handle!
Ingredients: ['6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves', '4 limes, juice of', '1 cup water', '2 teaspoons ground allspice', '12 teaspoon ground nutmeg', '1 teaspoon salt', '1 teaspoon brown sugar', '2 teaspoons dried thyme', '1 teaspoon ground ginger', '1 12 teaspoons ground black pepper', '2 tablespoons vegetable oil', '2 onions, chopped', '1 12 cups chopped green onions', '6 garlic cloves, chopped', '2 scotch bonnet peppers, chopped']
Instructions: ['Cut the chicken breasts into chunks.', 'Place chicken in a medium bowl.', 'Cover with lime juice and water.', 'Set aside.', 'In a blender or food processor, place allspice, nutmeg, salt, brown sugar, thyme, ginger, black pepper and vegetable oil.', 'Blend well, then mix in onions, green onions, garlic and habanero peppers until almost smooth.', 'Pour the blended marinade mixture into bowl with chicken.', 'Cover and marinate in the refrigerator at least 2 hours.', 'Preheat an outdoor grill for medium heat and lightly oil grate.', 'Cook chicken slowly on the preheated grill.', 'Turn frequently, basting often with remaining marinade mixture.', 'Cook to desired doneness.']

Name: Peppermint Candy Recipe
Ingredients: ['2 c. sugar', '3/4 c. boiling water', '1 tbsp. butter', '1/4 teaspoon baking soda', '1 tbsp. vinegar', '1/4 teaspoon peppermint extract']
Instructions: ['Stir together all the ingredients, except extract.', 'Boil till it reaches 300 degrees F. on candy thermometer or possibly when it cracks in cool water.', 'Pour into a buttered cookie sheet, cut into squares.']

Name: Autumn Pot Roast II
Ingredients: ['1 teaspoon salt', '2 tablespoons all-purpose flour', '1 (4 pound) boneless beef chuck roast', '2 cloves garlic, minced', '4 tablespoons butter', '1 large onion, sliced thin', '12 whole peppercorns', '12 whole allspice berries', '1 tablespoon finely grated raw horseradish', '1/2 cup bay leaf, crumbled', '1/2 cup rum', '1/2 cup water']
Instructions: ['Mix together salt and flour, and rub mixture into the meat.', 'In a Dutch oven, cook garlic in butter over medium heat.', 'Place meat into pan, and brown on all sides.', 'Remove beef from pan.', 'Arrange sliced onions in the bottom of the Dutch oven, and then place the meat on top of the onions.', 'Season with peppercorns, allspice, horseradish, and bay leaf.', 'Pour in rum.', 'Cover, and simmer over medium-low heat until tender, about 3 to 4 hours.', 'A good pot roast will supply most of its own juices, but as it cooks pour 1/2 cup water over it to make an ample supply of gravy.', 'Transfer roast to a platter.', 'Stir gravy until smooth, and pour over roast.']

Name: "nori's" Chicken Salad
Ingredients: ['2 large boneless skinless chicken breast halves', 'salt & fresh ground pepper (to taste)', "1 tablespoon soy sauce (or 2 tbsp. Bragg's Aminos)", '14 cup rice vinegar', '1 12 teaspoons Equal sugar substitute (or sugar)', 'crushed red pepper flakes (to taste)', '2 tablespoons olive oil', '6 cups napa cabbage (shredded)', '23 cup carrot (peeled, shredded)', '23 cup green onion (minced)', '23 cup almonds (chopped, toasted)', '14 cup cilantro (minced)', '2 sheets toasted nori (shredded)', '2 tablespoons sesame seeds (toasted)']

Name: Blueberry-Lemon Bread
Ingredients: ['1 1/2 cups all purpose flour', '1 teaspoon baking powder', '1/4 teaspoon salt', '6 tablespoons (3/4 stick) unsalted butter, room temperature', '1 1/3 cups sugar', '2 large eggs', '2 teaspoons grated lemon peel', '1/2 cup milk', '1 1/2 cups fresh blueberries or frozen, thawed, drained', '3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice']
Instructions: ['Preheat oven to 325F.', 'Butter 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan.', 'Combine first 3 ingredients in small bowl.', 'Using electric mixer, cream butter with 1 cup sugar in large bowl until mixture is light and fluffy.', 'Add eggs 1 at a time, beating well after each addition.', 'Add lemon peel.', 'Mix in dry ingredients alternatively with milk, beginning and ending with dry ingredients.', 'Fold in blueberries.', 'Spoon batter into prepared loaf pan.', 'Bake until golden brown and toothpick inserted into center comes out clean, about 1 hour 15 minutes.', 'Meanwhile, bring remaining 1/3 cup sugar and lemon juice to boil in small saucepan, stirring until sugar dissolves.', 'Pierce top of hot loaf several times with toothpick.', 'Pour hot lemon mixture over loaf in pan.', 'Cool 30 minutes in pan on rack.', 'Turn bread out of pan and cool completely on rack.']

Name: Watermelon Peach Tonic Smoothie
Ingredients: ['1/2 slice Peach', '1 cup watermelon--sliced into 1 inch cubes', '1/3 cup tonic water', '1 splash of cherry or orange juice']
Instructions: ['Put tonic water in first.', 'Then add fruit and other juices.', 'If you have watermelon juice from the sweet fruit add that in the blender too', 'Blend until desired consistency']

Name: Barbecue Beef and Rice
Ingredients: ['1 Tbsp. oil', '1/2 lb. (225 g) boneless beef sirloin steak, cut into thin strips', '1 small red pepper, cut into strips', '2 green onions, sliced', '1/4 cup Kraft Original BBQ Sauce', '1-1/3 cups hot cooked long-grain white rice']
Instructions: ['Heat oil in large skillet on medium-high heat.', 'Add meat and vegetables; cook and stir 5 to 6 min.', 'or until meat is done.', 'Add barbecue sauce; cook 5 min.', 'or until heated through, stirring occasionally.', 'Serve over rice.']

Name: Cinnamon Biscuit Crunchies
Ingredients: ['2 cups Sugar', '2 Tablespoons Ground Cinnamon (more Or Less To Taste)', '1 can (16.3 Oz. Can) Biscuits (I Use Grands)', '1 stick Butter Or Margarine, Melted', '8 teaspoons Jam Or Jelly - Your Favorite Flavor(s)']
Instructions: ['Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.', 'Combine sugar and cinnamon in a bowl.', 'Dip each biscuit in melted butter and turn to coat.', 'Then dip into the sugar-cinnamon combo and coat well.', 'Place on an ungreased cookie sheet and with your thumb, make a deep well in the center of each biscuit.', 'Fill the well of each biscuit with a teaspoon of your favorite jam or jelly.', 'Bake according to package directions.']

Name: Sweet & Savoury Brussels Sprouts

Name: Potato Salad Seasoning
Ingredients: ['1 tablespoon black pepper', '1 teaspoon salt', '12 tablespoon chicken bouillon powder', '1 tablespoon dried parsley', '12 teaspoon garlic powder', '12 tablespoon onion powder', '12 teaspoon celery seed', '1 teaspoon marjoram leaves', '1 large bay leaf']

Name: Muddy Buddies II
Ingredients: ['34 cup peanut butter', '1 cup chocolate chips', '5 -6 cups Corn Chex or 5 -6 cups Rice Chex', 'powdered sugar']

Name: Citrus Avocado Salad
Ingredients: ['12 cup canola oil', '14 cup sugar', '3 tablespoons lemon juice', '1 12 teaspoons poppy seeds', '12 teaspoon salt (or to taste)', '14 teaspoon ground mustard', '14 teaspoon grated onion', '12 cups torn salad greens', '2 medium grapefruits, peeled and sectioned (be sure to remove all the pith and the membranes)', '2 medium navel oranges, peeled and sectioned (be sure to remove all the pith and membranes)', '2 medium ripe avocados, peeled and sliced', '1 small red onion, very thinly sliced and separated into rings']
Instructions: ['To make dressing, combine all dressing ingredients in a jar.', 'Shake until well mixed.', 'Set aside.', 'Place salad greens in a large bowl.', 'Add grapefruit sections, orange sections, avocado slices, and onion rings.', 'Toss gently to combine.', 'Shake dressing again if needed.', 'Drizzle over salad, toss to coat, and serve.']

Name: Beef jerky recipe
Ingredients: ['1 kg (2.2lbs) topside of beef', '1 tsp black peppercorns, crushed', '1 tsp garlic powder', '1 tsp cayenne pepper', '1 tsp chilli powder', '2 tsp onion powder or half a grated small onion', '5 tbsp light soy sauce', '3 tbsp Worcestershire sauce', '1 tsp sugar or honey (optional)']
Instructions: ['Preparing and marinating the meat: use a sharp knife to remove visible sinew and fat from the meat.', 'Cut the meat into thin strips.', 'To make the finished jerky easier to chew, cut across the grain of the muscle.', 'It is easier to slice the meat when it has been partially frozen as it tends to hold its shape better.', 'Partially frozen meat can usually be passed through a meat slicer to get really thin and even slices.', 'But you may prefer (as I do) to cut the strips by hand as this saves on cleaning a machine.', 'Mix all the ingredients of your chosen marinade recipe together in a bowl and add the strips of beef.', 'Mix well to coat them completely.', 'Cover with clingfilm and allow the meat to marinate in the refrigerator for 24 hours.', 'To dry the meat: remove the meat from the marinade and arrange the strips of beef on a wire rack, keeping them separate from each other and as flat as possible.', 'Set the oven at 50C and place the loaded wire racks in the oven.', 'Keep the door of the oven slightly open to allow the moisture in the meat to evaporate.', 'This should take about 4 to 5 hours to complete.', 'The drying time will be quicker if you use a fan oven.', 'Check the meat every half hour and rearrange the racks so the meat dries evenly.', 'Youll notice as the meat dries, it darkens in colour and shrinks a little.', 'Your jerky is done when it is dry to the point where the meat shows some resistance to bending but does not snap.', 'If the meat snaps, this indicates that it has become over dry.']

Name: Melting Moments

Name: Breakfast Sausage- Low Cholesterol
Ingredients: ['1 pound ground turkey', '1/2 teaspoon salt', '1/2 teaspoon black pepper', '1/2 teaspoon paprika', '1 teaspoon sage ground', '1 small onions chopped', '1/4 cup bread crumbs', '1 tablespoon vegetable oil']
